title: Empowering teams to unlock insights faster at OpenAI
summary: OpenAI’s research assistant helps teams analyze millions of support tickets, surface insights faster, and scale curiosity across the company.
body: OpenAI’s research assistant helps teams analyze millions of support tickets, surface insights faster, and scale curiosity across the company.
summaryZh: OpenAI展示了其内部研发的研究助手如何帮助团队分析数百万条支持工单，快速提取核心业务洞察，并在公司内部规模化应用以提升问题处理与数据挖掘的效率。原始信息显示：OpenAI’s research assistant helps teams analyze millions of support tickets, surface insights faster, and scale curiosity across the company.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Empowering teams to unlock insights faster at OpenAI”。其重要性主要体现在：展示了OpenAI利用研究助手分析海量支持工单的内部案例，反映了大模型在企业知识检索与分析中的应用。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
